hero.desc: Build screens faster and more accurately with AI Composer.

guideCard.title: ‘Natural Language Generation’ Guide
guideCard.desc: The most flexible mode. Write your screen requirements as natural-language sentences, and Claude generates the pattern, data binding, SP, and menu SQL together.
guideCard.step2: Type requirements in the large textarea (e.g., “Create a user-by-department/position management screen. Filters: department, user name. Grid: code, name, email.”)
guideCard.step3: Optional — choose one or several of these:
guideCard.sub1: Pick SCM UI Mockup — one production mockup as reference (mockup ↔ UI Pattern are mutually exclusive)
guideCard.sub2: Pick UI Pattern — one T3MES pattern as reference markup
guideCard.sub3: Attach reference files — SQL, design images, screenshots (up to 5, 5MB each · text inlined into prompt · images use Anthropic vision)
guideCard.sub4: Pick Data Source — DB Entity (pick table/SP from constellation map) · Ontology Q&A · inline query
guideCard.step4: Click [Start Generation] → Composer workspace opens; Claude emits 6–8 artifacts marked with ===FILE:
guideCard.step5: The right [Screen LIVE] tab automatically shows the preview
guideCard.step6: With ‘auto-fix on error’ ON, Claude attempts one self-fix automatically
